title.en: Claude API Key Setup Guide for New Teams
title.zh: Claude API Key 开通与团队接入指南

excerpt.en: Set up Anthropic API access, verify request headers, and prepare rate-limit-aware integration from day one.
excerpt.zh: 完成 Anthropic API 接入、请求头校验与限流预案，让团队从第一天就按生产标准使用 Claude。

en: Before coding, define who owns Anthropic billing, who manages API keys, and which environments will use Claude. This avoids ad-hoc key sharing later.
For production, keep a clear owner for key rotation and incident response.
zh: 接入前先明确 Anthropic 账单归属、密钥管理员和各环境使用边界，避免后期临时共享密钥。
生产环境建议指定固定负责人，统一处理轮换与安全事件。

en: Anthropic API requests require x-api-key and anthropic-version headers. If either is missing or incorrect, your first integration tests may fail even when the key is valid.
Start from the official curl example and only then port into SDK or framework wrappers.
zh: Anthropic API 请求需要 x-api-key 和 anthropic-version 头。即使 Key 正确，只要头信息缺失或错误，也会导致接入失败。
建议先用官方 curl 示例打通，再迁移到 SDK 或框架封装。

heading.zh: 3）在服务端通过 SDK 接入

en: Install Anthropic SDKs in your backend service and load API keys from server environment variables. Avoid direct browser usage in production workflows.
Keep environment-level key separation so staging tests cannot drain production quotas.
zh: 在后端服务中安装 Anthropic SDK，并从服务端环境变量读取 Key。生产流程避免浏览器端直接持有密钥。
建议按环境隔离密钥，避免测试流量误耗生产额度。

heading.en: 4) Design for rate limits from the start
heading.zh: 4）从一开始就按限流模型设计

en: Anthropic documents token-bucket rate limiting and recommends monitoring usage in Claude Console. Build retry logic with backoff and keep request bursts under control.
When you receive 429, check whether traffic spikes, per-model limits, or shared org usage caused the bottleneck.
zh: Anthropic 文档说明其限流基于 token bucket，并建议在 Claude Console 监控使用情况。你需要实现带退避的重试并控制突发流量。
出现 429 时，要优先判断是瞬时突发、模型限额，还是组织内共享额度被占满。

en: Implement exponential backoff for retriable failures
Review Usage charts in Claude Console
zh: 对可重试错误使用指数退避
按模型维度统计 429 比例
在 Claude Console 使用量图表中持续复盘

en: Before launch, verify key scope, logging, timeout strategy, and fallback behavior. This reduces firefighting during early traffic growth.
Treat model integration as an SRE concern: observability and key hygiene are as important as prompt quality.
zh: 上线前要核对密钥范围、日志字段、超时策略和降级策略，避免流量初期频繁救火。
模型接入不仅是 Prompt 工程，也属于稳定性工程：可观测性与密钥治理同样重要。

question.en: Why do I get errors even though my key looks valid?
question.zh: 为什么 Key 看起来正确，但请求还是报错？

answer.en: Check required headers first. Missing anthropic-version or malformed x-api-key headers are common setup issues.
answer.zh: 先检查必填请求头。anthropic-version 缺失或 x-api-key 格式错误是高频原因。

question.zh: 遇到 429 应该怎么处理？

answer.en: Add exponential backoff with jitter, reduce burstiness, and monitor org/model-level usage in Claude Console.
answer.zh: 实现带抖动的指数退避，降低突发请求，并在 Claude Console 查看组织与模型维度使用情况。

question.en: Can staging and production share the same key?
question.zh: 测试环境和生产环境可以共用 Key 吗？

answer.en: Not recommended. Separate keys improve isolation, budget control, and incident recovery speed.
answer.zh: 不建议。分离 Key 能提升隔离性、预算控制和故障恢复效率。
